headline: Exchange Intake Rises To 883.2 Million Dollars From 695.1 Million, With Bitstamp At 234.2 Million
narrative: Clean-asset intake across 79 exchanges rose to 883.2 million dollars from 695.1 million, equal to 0.327 percent of the 270.1 billion dollars held on those venues, compared with 0.2564 percent of 271.1 billion on the prior reading. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bitstamp intake stands at 234.2 million dollars and Binance intake stands at 522.9 million dollars, while Bitfinex intake fell to 126.4 million dollars from 173.3 million and Bybit sent out 24.5 million dollars.
author: jordan
